description: Source code for a Mattermost plugin providing slash command handlers for load testing various features such as creating users, channels, posts, DMs, threaded posts, and loading data from URLs or JSON payloads.

classes.name: LoadTestProvider
classes.description: Implements command provider for load testing slash commands in Mattermost.

methods.name: GetTrigger
methods.description: Returns the trigger string for the command provider, which is 'test'.

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Returns the command configuration if testing is enabled.

methods.name: DoCommand
methods.description: Executes the appropriate subcommand based on the message prefix.

methods.name: doCommand
methods.description: Handles specific load test commands like setup, users, channels, dms, posts, post, url, json, etc.

methods.name: HelpCommand
methods.description: Returns the help text with usage instructions.

methods.name: SetupCommand
methods.description: Creates a testing environment with specified number of teams, channels, users, and posts.

methods.name: ActivateUserCommand
methods.description: Activates a user by user ID.

methods.name: DeActivateUserCommand
methods.description: Deactivates a user by user ID.

methods.name: UsersCommand
methods.description: Creates a number of test users with optional fuzz and time parameters.

methods.name: ChannelsCommand
methods.description: Creates test channels with optional fuzz, range, type, and time parameters.

methods.name: DmsCommand
methods.description: Creates direct message conversations with specified users.

methods.name: ThreadedPostCommand
methods.description: Creates threaded posts with nested replies.

methods.name: PostsCommand
methods.description: Creates multiple posts with optional fuzz, range, images, and time parameters.

methods.name: PostCommand
methods.description: Creates a single post in a specified channel as a specified user.

methods.name: URLCommand
methods.description: Loads content from a URL and posts it in the current channel.

methods.name: JSONCommand
methods.description: Loads a post from a JSON payload from a URL.
